import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int T = 1; // As per original code, T is fixed to 1
        for (int _ = 0; _ < T; _++) {
            processCase(scanner);
        }
        scanner.close();
    }

    static void processCase(Scanner scanner) {
        int total = scanner.nextInt();
        int factor = scanner.nextInt();

        int[] sequence = new int[total];
        for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            sequence[i] = (factor * i) % total;
        }

        if (factor == 0) {
            System.out.println(powMod(total, total - 1, MOD));
            return;
        }

        boolean[] visited = new boolean[total];
        int[] cycleCounts = new int[total + 1]; // size total+1 for safety
        long result = 1;

        for (int startNode = 0; startNode < total; startNode++) {
            if (visited[startNode]) continue;
            int length = 0;
            int currentNode = startNode;
            while (!visited[currentNode]) {
                visited[currentNode] = true;
                currentNode = sequence[currentNode];
                length++;
            }
            cycleCounts[length]++;
        }

        for (int size = 1; size < total; size++) {
            if (cycleCounts[size] != 0) {
                long totalValue = size * cycleCounts[size] + (size > 1 ? cycleCounts[1] : 0);
                long power = cycleCounts[size];
                long temp = powMod(totalValue, power, MOD);
                result = (result * temp) % MOD;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(result);
    }

    static long powMod(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long curr = base % mod;
        long e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * curr) % mod;
            }
            curr = (curr * curr) % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
